clearAll.title: Clear All
clearAll.message: Are you sure you want to clear all fields, stages, games, teams, and groups? This action cannot be undone.

tournamentGenerator.title: Generate Tournament
tournamentGenerator.warningMessage: Generating a new tournament will PERMANENTLY delete your current schedule and fields. This action cannot be undone.
tournamentGenerator.durationValidation: Duration must be between 15 and 180 minutes.
tournamentGenerator.insufficientTeams: Not enough teams in the pool. This format requires at least {{min}} teams, or select 'Generate teams automatically'.

publishConfirmation.title: Publish Schedule
publishConfirmation.description: Publishing the schedule will lock its structure. Results can be entered, but games and teams cannot be added or removed.
publishConfirmation.errorsDescription: The following issues must be resolved before the schedule can be published:
publishConfirmation.warningsDescription: The schedule has some potential issues. You can still publish, but please review these items:
publishConfirmation.ready: The schedule is valid and ready to be published.

teamSelection.title: Connect Existing Team
teamSelection.noResults: No teams found matching your search.
teamSelection.hint: Enter at least 2 characters to search.

swissSetup.title: Configure Tournament — Swiss System
swissSetup.subtitle: Rank the teams once by seed, then fix rounds, fields and game duration. Round 1 generates automatically from here.
swissSetup.seedHint: Seeds stay fixed for the whole tournament — only the pairings change each round.
swissSetup.scheduleHint: Auto-calculated from rounds, fields and duration. Round times stay adjustable per round later.

swissAdjust.title: Adjust Round {{n}}
swissAdjust.description: Review the proposed pairings and adjust them before generating. You can swap teams, change the bye team, field or start time.
